draft_answer: Team ES2002 first agreed on using regular batteries as their power source, though they later considered adding kinetic power before finalizing on battery power only. Their project manager, Laura, liked the idea of adding a lighting feature to illuminate the buttons for use in the dark. The final design used an LCD screen with plastic double-curved casing and standard battery power without kinetic power or rubber.
